results.details: All 21 listed scalar integer operation families have Pattern.Valid proofs for poison on either operand. Extended operations create and prove poison for both results. Source UB exclusions for division/remainder remain in their interpretation; right-poison divisor cases are vacuous only when source interpretation is undefined. The patterns are independently checked and do not encode upstream early-return priority.
results.scope: 17 single-result scalar integer ops (addi, subi, muli, divui, divsi, ceildivui, ceildivsi, floordivsi, remui, remsi, andi, ori, xori, maxsi, maxui, minsi, minui); four two-result scalar extended ops (addui_extended, subui_extended, mulsi_extended, mului_extended). Floating-point and shaped variants are outside current integer Puddle model. Upstream excludes shifts, cmpi, cmpf, select.
